labels.lem:root-elliptic-double-cover-lines: Recomputed all pairwise divisor intersections, ampleness, Euler characteristic and the integral polarization matrix/Smith kernel. Reproved stability of q_*O(H+Gamma) by the negative effective-square obstruction, then global generation from the negative-slope dual and relative degree-two evaluation. Cartier(dx)=0 gives the stated supersingular product.
labels.lem:root-double-cover-branch-module: Reproved the actual stalkwise diagonal/sum exact sequence across wild branch points, finite direct-image acyclicity, both cohomology identifications and their natural Galois equivariance. The argument is on the geometric generic fibre, so no unproved etaleness of a branch family or residue-field separability is used. Nonempty branch set follows from H1(E,F2)=0.
labels.thm:root-primitive-prime-permutation-cou: Freshly reread the complete primitive-prime generic-rank canonical and checked every hypothesis for the explicit L_m. Degree-two separability follows from unequal genera (or stable rank). The branch module has exactly n geometric points because f(C)=n-1. Artin-Schreier plus zero ambient stable part identifies this actual permutation representation with the relative Lang representation. Generic Galois image equals geometric local-system image; S_n is faithful and proper in GL_(n-1)(F2).
labels.cor:root-primitive-permutation-Lang-comp: For odd n, complement pairs have unique representative weight 1 through (n-1)/2. These nonempty invariant subsets have the indicated binomial sizes and yield open-and-closed subcovers; no transitivity or exact S_n image is inferred.
labels.rem:root-primitive-permutation-scope: The examples are actual ample globally generated primitive lines but are not very ample, because fibre restrictions have degree two. Distinct L_m are not powers of a fixed embedding line. No contradiction to fixed-principal-cube results or sufficiently-large powers, and no exceptional theta ratio, is claimed.
